newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal sees higher profit for 1996.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal sees higher profit for 1996.

text.p: French cosmetics group L'Oreal reiterated on Friday that it expected a higher profit for 1996.
"The first estimations of the profit for the year 1996 are on line with the trends mentioned in October 1996," the company said in a statement announcing a 13 percent sales rise for 1996.

In October L'Oreal said it expected to report a rise in profit -- before tax, employee profit-sharing and capital gains or losses and after interest expense -- close to the growth in sales for the year, which it then estimated at around 12 percent.
It also said in October the rise in 1996 profit before capital gains or losses and after minority interests would be greater than the 8.3 percent profit gain recorded for 1995.
